description: Dunit musl port (M6-D) process model — posix_spawn + waitpid over native SpawnArgs/WaitProcess. userspace/ctests/musl_spawn.c spawns /app/musl_child with argv, waits, checks the child printed its args and exited with code 7. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_spawn_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: posix_spawn launched the child and passed argv through the native SpawnArgs
the parent reaped the child via waitpid (native WaitProcess)
waitpid reported WIFEXITED with WEXITSTATUS 7 — exit status crossed the process boundary
posix_spawn + waitpid work end to end
posix_spawn with a file action is refused with a documented ENOSYS, not silently ignored (M6.1)
